user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with the maximum allowed guests (10) so that boundary values are handled correctly.

positive.title: Create Booking with Maximum Allowed Guests
steps: Select the number of guests as 10.
Fill in other required booking details.
positive.expected_result: The booking is successfully created with 10 guests and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Create Booking Exceeding Maximum Guests
steps: Select the number of guests as 11.
Fill in other required booking details.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the maximum allowed number of guests is 10.

edge.title: Create Booking with No Guests
steps: Select the number of guests as 0.
Fill in other required booking details.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that at least one guest must be selected.
